page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory alongside dual entry-level enterprise GPUs. The lack of local NVMe storage and the reliance on older-generation NVIDIA P4 GPUs represent key architectural tradeoffs, positioning this server as a cost-effective option for legacy GPU workloads rather than high-demand modern AI training.

Appropriate workloads for this instance include GPU-accelerated video transcoding, low-latency inference, entry-level machine learning workloads, and general-purpose applications requiring parallel processing capabilities.
